newsitem.title: CHINA: China's average life expectancy at 70.80 in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China's average life expectancy at 70.80 in 1996.

text.p: The average life expectancy in China in 1996 was 70.80 years, compared to 68.55 years in 1990, an official of the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
The life expectancy for men was 68.71 years in 1996, an increase of 1.87 years over 1990, while that for women was 73.04 years, rising by 2.57 years compared to 1990, he said.
China reported 7.99 million deaths last year, with a death rate of 5.56 per 1,000, the bureau said.
